statements.description: Expected-behaviour statements. Empty is a valid, honest answer for a feature the oracle could not find any sourced behaviour for.

statement.description: One expected behaviour, stated as a fact about the system.

source_kind.description: Where this statement came from — never left implicit.

source.description: The concrete citation: an AC id, a spec section, a file:line, or a description of the observed behaviour. Mandatory — a statement with no source is the model inventing a requirement.
